description: The line plot illustrates the performance of CodeRAG-Bench with different chunking sizes, represented by the number of tokens on the x-axis and the performance metric on the y-axis. The x-axis ranges from 200 to 900 tokens, with tick labels at intervals of 200 tokens. The y-axis ranges from 10 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different chunking size: Tutorials (blue), Library Documentation (red), StackOverflow posts (yellow), and Github files (green). The Tutorials line starts at a performance value of around 20, peaks at around 30, and ends at around 25. The Library Documentation line starts at around 30, peaks at around 35, and ends at around 30. The StackOverflow posts line starts at around 30, peaks at around 35, and ends at around 20. The Github files line starts at around 30, peaks at around 35, and ends at around 25.
